label: late-episode drop (last ~5 trials), deeper at D2 in S1, after no reward, and at low value
terms: (phase != D2) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/3.) ;; (phase == D2) * (state==1) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/3.) ;; (phase != D2) * value * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/3.) ;; (phase == D2) * value * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/3.) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward==0) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/3.) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward==0) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/3.) ;; (phase == D2) * (state==1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_action == 1)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 30 sits near 1 (mean 0.987) and its variance is dominated by a sharp drop in the last ~5 trials of the episode; the decile timing baseline (R^2 0.63) misses the within-decile ramp, so an exponential ramp exp((ep_trial-99)/3) per phase carries most of the extra fit (about 0.23 dev on its own, above the 0.21 additive ceiling of the profile cues). On top of the ramp, the late drop is deeper at D2 when the reached state is S1 (the strongest interaction), after an unrewarded previous trial at GO and especially D2, and smaller when the model value is high (value x ramp, positive weight). Outside the late window the effects are small: D1 after a1->S2 (rare) trials is lower (~-0.013) and D2 in S1 is slightly lower (~-0.006). Hidden good state, since-reversal and future cues add little (profile tables <= 0.02). Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.46 with 8 terms, using only observed variables plus the model value.
